title: Crispy Dark Matter: A Pre-Registered Accommodation Ledger for an Evolving Acceleration Scale
description:
If the acceleration scale a0 of the mass-discrepancy-acceleration relation is set by the dark-energy density, a0 = (1/2)c sqrt(G rho_Lambda), then a measured evolution of rho_Lambda forces a0 to evolve with no additional parameters, while LCDM's emergent acceleration scale naturally tracks H(z). The difference is an ABSORPTION FUNCTION A(z) that any LCDM account of a measured a0(z) must supply through halo concentration evolution and baryonic feedback. We name the accommodated model CRISPY DARK MATTER and register its required content in advance, so that if it is later constructed, the accommodation is recognisable as parameters spent rather than a prediction fulfilled. This is a forecast object, not an attribution: no one has proposed this model, and adjusting free sectors to new data is normal science.

Computed on four verified DESI DR2 w0waCDM fits (Pantheon+, DES-Dovekie, Union3, BAO+CMB), with the Occam ledger in bans. Three findings REDUCE the claim: (1) most of the naive 0.25 dex requirement at z=1 is the pre-existing constant-a0-vs-E(z) tension LCDM already absorbs -- the DESI-dependent signal is ~0.01 dex at z=1, changes sign near z~1, and reaches only 0.11-0.20 dex by z=3, making this a z>~2 test; (2) on the alternative cH(z)/Z footing the absorption function is identically zero and the test is empty -- the footing choice IS the experiment; (3) the input (w0,wa) were inferred assuming standard inertia (cH0/a0 = 7.0), so 'parameter-free' is conditional on an unbuilt MI cosmology. A mutually exclusive constant-Lambda reading of the same data is stated alongside, decided by a ~0.05 dex high-z measurement. Falsification conditions are symmetric, including DESI DR3+ reverting to w0=-1, wa=0, which deletes the prediction entirely. All numbers produced by committed scripts that exit nonzero on any failed check.
notes: Pre-registered forecast, frozen 2026-07-30. The scoreboard in Section 9 is the frozen content: what counts as accommodation, and what falsifies the framework, stated symmetrically before the data. The interpolating kernel nu(y)=sqrt(1+1/y) is Milgrom 1999 PLA 253:273 Eq 9; the framework's distinctive content is the cH_Lambda/Z coefficient and the modified-inertia completion. kappa=1/2 is not derived.
